audit.report: A replayable batch job (inventory_reconcile, pid 703115) held locks idle-in-transaction for 4.1s, blocking checkout and dropping success to 27% with $13,382/min revenue at risk. audit.root_cause: The inventory_reconcile batch job entered an idle-in-transaction state while holding locks that blocked all checkout sessions.
